result_summary.title: SSO Integration Module timeouts linked to vendor status page
result_summary.description: Users in the ME production region are experiencing timeouts when using the SSO Integration Module. We checked the vendor status page and there is a known incident listed. This seems to be an upstream dependency issue causing our logins to fail for about 20 users. We need confirmation if there is a workaround on our side or if we just need to wait for the vendor.

final_diagnosis.recommended_next_action: Wait for the vendor to resolve the issue and monitor the SSO Integration Module for any further issues.
final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The SSO Integration Module timeouts are likely caused by an upstream dependency issue, which is a third-party service failure. The affected component is the Social Login Connector (COMPONENT_THR), and the owning team is the Identity team (TEAM_GKJ). The evidence from the telemetry data (EVIDENCE_HGM and EVIDENCE_SLL) supports this hypothesis.
